source: gmlRicochet 09-05-13_2.20am (GameMaker 8.1 / Studio project, "Beta 18"), read by Tools/import-gml-fonts.ps1; paths below are relative to it

outline.what: draw_text_outline(x, y, size, text) draws the text in black at every whole-pixel offset up to size in x and y, then in white on top, and restores the colour; the rebuild draws it as a black SDF outline size px wide around white text, one outlined material per size the original calls it with

licences.owner: Monotype (designed by Geoffrey Lee, 1965, for Stephenson Blake); licensed to Microsoft, which ships it with Windows
licences.licence: Proprietary. The Windows licence lets the font be used on that machine, not redistributed as a font file.
licences.rebuild: Not shipped. Only GameMaker's rasterised atlases of it (fnt_impact, fnt_score, fnt_score_shadow, fnt_count, fnt_small) are imported, which is what the original game itself shipped.
